name: dunbarslots
title: dunbarslots
blurb: a METR-style chart of how many of your ~150 Dunbar slots are spent modeling the personality of a different AI model, with an exponential trend line telling you exactly when you max out — now with checkboxes to forget categories of real humans (old friends, work buddies, family, kids) and pad your cap above 150. built off @norvid-studies.bsky.social's joke, forwarded by @mfzx.net, extended by @shimmermathlabs.com.
